metric_policy: Shellwise FSC and normalized FSC-AUC only; correlation is not computed or gated.
fixture_policy: Version 2 keeps the version 1 case parameters and artifact-pinned fixtures and changes only the final-map contract: final all-data maps are gridding-corrected as in RELION. Newly generated datasets remain non-scoring replicate diagnostics.

regeneration.method: regenerated post hoc with RELION griddingCorrect on the saved final maps

gridding.formula: map / sinc^2(r / (N * padding_factor)), r from voxel index N/2
gridding.applies_to: final merged map only; numbered iterations and final_half*_unfil.mrc were already corrected
